description: Paginated user reviews. sort=recent is best for monitoring new feedback; sort=helpful surfaces the loudest complaints. Page with offset and stop when has_more is false.

app_id.description: iOS numeric id or Android package name.

country.description: ISO-2 storefront code, e.g. us, gb, de, jp. Defaults to us.

offset.description: How many reviews to skip, for pagination.

store.description: Store to query: "ios" (Apple App Store) or "android" (Google Play).

name: get_app_reviews
title: App reviews
